items.title: How IGNYTE runs candidate search with Amazon S3 Vectors
items.summary: Ignyte moved the embeddings for more than 1 billion contacts from Amazon OpenSearch Service to Amazon S3 Vectors, keeping OpenSearch Service for structured filtering. See the per-continent index layout, the minimal-metadata design, and the batch pipeline behind its two-hop semantic candidate search.
items.creator: Saurabh Gupta

items.title: Deploy Amazon S3 Files with Terraform
items.summary: Amazon S3 Files makes Amazon S3 buckets accessible as NFS mounts from AWS compute resources. This post walks through a Terraform module that deploys S3 Files end-to-end: multi-AZ mount targets, security groups, IAM policies, encryption, and Amazon CloudWatch monitoring.
items.creator: Karthik Akula
